draft.emotion: tense and alert, body slightly drawn back in alarm
notes: Covers both 'scary' and 'afraid' in English. The thing you fear is marked with が (ga): 私は犬が怖い means 'Dogs are scary to me', i.e. 'I am afraid of dogs'.
Do not confuse with 恐ろしい (osoroshii), which is more formal and describes things that are truly terrifying.
